mainEntity.name: How do I book an appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a service in the Square scheduler, select an available appointment and follow the booking steps. Review the service details and booking terms before confirming.

mainEntity.name: What if the booking menu does not load?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Open Full Booking Menu to open the same scheduler directly. You can also text 262-939-9325 for help choosing a service.
Explore our massage, facial, Japanese Head Spa, lash, waxing and wellness pages for treatment details. If you are unsure which option fits, text us before booking.

mainEntity.name: Who qualifies for the introductory facial offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: The introductory facial is for guests new to Matrix facial services, including existing massage, Head Spa and wellness guests who have not had a facial here. Read the full offer terms before booking.

mainEntity.name: How do I receive the $85 facial follow-up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reserve the recommended 60-minute Custom Facial follow-up before leaving your introductory appointment. It is arranged at checkout, subject to availability, and cannot be combined with other promotions.
All appointments are at Matrix Massage & Bodywork, 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168. We welcome guests from Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Bristol, Twin Lakes, Kenosha, Union Grove and nearby Antioch.

mainEntity.name: How do I change an appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check your Square confirmation for appointment-management options and the booking terms. If you need assistance, text 262-939-9325. Cancellation and rescheduling policies shown during booking apply.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a gift card instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Visit our gift card page to purchase an eGift card. Buying a gift card does not reserve an appointment; the recipient can book a service separately.
